scope: One complete matched successful pair; second candidate interrupted by external OCR connectivity loss; baseline2 not run. Preflights excluded.

units.time: Unix seconds/UTC or durations explicitly named

latency.method: Claim times are derived from retained lease_until minus job timeout. Queue/staging/acceptance times are bounded by consecutive database observations requested every 100ms; intermediate transitions can be missed. Metadata child IDs use the source-defined uuid5(parent, metadata). Search association uses creation windows, not query-result equality.
